english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something throws a situation into confusion or disorder.

exampleSentences.english: This heavy rain can disrupt our whole itinerary.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢場大雨搞亂晒我哋成個行程。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 gaau2 lyun6 saai3 ngo5 dei6 sing4 go3 haang4 cing4

english.note: Use this when something is physically or organizationally put into disorder rather than when someone is made uneasy.

exampleSentences.english: Moving house can unsettle all our original arrangements.
exampleSentences.traditional: 搬屋搞亂晒我哋原本嘅安排。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bun1 uk1 gaau2 lyun6 saai3 ngo5 dei6 jyun4 bun2 ge3 on1 paai4

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on putting something into disorder rather than completely ruining it.

exampleSentences.english: You mess up all the files whenever you move them.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你一郁啲文件就搞亂晒。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 jat1 juk1 di1 man4 gin2 zau6 gaau2 lyun6 saai3

english.note: Use this when something is made messy or disordered, such as a bed or someone's hair.

exampleSentences.english: The kids tumble around on the bed and mess it all up.
exampleSentences.traditional: 細路仔喺張床度跳嚟跳去，搞亂晒張床。
exampleSentences.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 zoeng1 cong4 dou6 tiu3 lei4 tiu3 heoi3 gaau2 lyun6 saai3 zoeng1 cong4
